reference: She wears the skirt in the park every Sunday.
sk: Túto sukňu nosí do parku každú nedeľu.
cz: Tuhle sukni nosí do parku každou neděli.
acceptable: Every Sunday {she|he} wears {this|the} skirt {to|in} the park.

mistakes.text: {She|He} wear this skirt to the park every Sunday.
{She|He} is wearing this skirt to the park every Sunday.
{She|He} carries this skirt to the park every Sunday.
{She|He} wears this skirt to the park every Sundays.

source_issues: SK/CZ say 'this skirt' and 'to the park' (Túto/do parku); reference has 'the skirt in the park'. No subject pronoun in SK/CZ.
